settings.title: Settings
settings.showSelfAvatarDesc: Show your avatar beside the first message in each group.
settings.chatOpenLatestDesc: Open conversations at the newest message.
settings.chatOpenLastReadDesc: When unread messages exist, start at the first unread message.
settings.uploadConcurrencyHint: Maximum uploads shared across all conversations. Files in the same conversation upload in order.

settings.dataHint: Review and clear local chat caches
settings.cacheStorageHint: Clearing affects only this device. Server messages, sign-in state and the thread list are kept.
settings.clearChatCacheDesc: Deletes cached messages, images and video files.
settings.clearChatCacheConfirm: This closes every chat window and deletes messages and media files cached on this device. Server messages are not deleted.
settings.clearChatCacheFailed: The local chat cache could not be fully cleared. Please try again.
settings.cacheStatsFailed: Local cache usage could not be read.
settings.mediaCacheClearFailed: Could not clear the media cache.
settings.notifDesc: Show a desktop alert when a new message arrives while this tab is in the background.
settings.notifGrantedHint: On. Turn it off in your browser's site settings to revoke.
settings.notifDeniedHint: Blocked by your browser. Allow notifications in this site's settings to enable.
settings.notifUnsupportedHint: Requires HTTPS (or localhost). Notifications aren't available on this origin.
settings.notifDesktopDesc: Pop up a system notification when a new message arrives while this tab is in the background.
settings.notifSoundDesc: Play the system sound when a notification appears.
settings.notifGroupingDesc: Show recent messages, or only indicate that new messages arrived.
settings.notifAlertFrequencyDesc: Limit sound and vibration when messages arrive continuously.
settings.notifSoundVibrateDesc: Customize the ringtone and vibration in system settings.
settings.usingLanHint: Using the second server — the primary server is currently unreachable.
settings.realtimeDesc: The persistent server stream that delivers live messages.
settings.healthDesc: Probe the server's liveness endpoint (no sign-in needed).
settings.notifPermGrantedHint: On. Turn them off in system settings to revoke.
settings.notifPermOffHint: Allow notifications to receive push for new messages.
settings.notifPermBlockedHint: Notifications are blocked. Enable them in system settings.
settings.notifPermFgsSuppressedHint: System notifications are off — the keep-alive service runs but its notification is hidden.
settings.keepAliveFgsDesc: Holds a live background connection so messages arrive in near-real-time when FCM is unavailable. Bounded to ~6h/day by Android.
settings.fgsHintFcmActive: FCM is active — foreground service not needed
settings.keepAlivePollDesc: Check for new messages roughly every 6 hours. Turn off to save battery — notifications may arrive late.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Send logs to your admin for support
settings.diagnosticsDesc: Upload a diagnostic bundle (Rust + native logs, web console, and version info) for support.
settings.diagnosticsConsent: Sends the app's logs (Rust, plus native logs on debug builds), the web console, and version info to your admin. It may include URLs and account identifiers.
settings.diagnosticsFailedHint: Could not send now — saved locally, will retry on next launch.
settings.upToDateHint: You have the latest version installed. No action is needed.
